name: Icon
label: Icon
description: One Material Symbol on the icon scale, decorative or named, plain or on a round tile.

props.name: name
props.description: The Material Symbol's name (`settings`, `arrow_forward`). A glyph that points along the reading direction mirrors in a right-to-left context.

props.name: size
props.description: The size, as a step on the icon scale (`--icon-size-600`, the size beside body text, by default).

props.name: tone
props.description: The glyph's colour role. `inherit` takes the colour of the text around it.

props.name: filled
props.description: Draws the filled form of the glyph, as a selected nav item does.

props.name: label
props.description: What the icon means, when it carries meaning no text beside it says. With a label the icon is an image with that name; without one it is decorative and hidden from assistive tech.

props.name: tile
props.description: Sets the glyph on a round tile of the icon fill, the mark at the head of a stat card or a list row.
